42K likes, 1,088 comments - kondhwatimespune on August 30, 2026: "Karan Kundrra Receives Green Crusader 2026 Award 🌱🏆

📍 Pune | August 30, 2026

Actor and television personality Karan Kundrra was honoured with the Green Crusader 2026 Award for his influence on the younger generation and his continued support for environmental causes.

With his voice, reach and public influence, Karan has been an active face and voice for Bhamla Foundation campaigns, supporting initiatives including beach clean-ups and tree plantation drives. 🌳🌊

His recognition celebrates not just his talent, but his commitment to using his influence to inspire young people towards greater environmental awareness and action.

🌱 The award is an initiative of Bhamla Foundation and Panchshil Group.

📸 Kondhwa Times Pune
